fields.name: Am Bush
fields.description: A shrub that passes for harmless hedge until something warm-blooded wanders close, then volleys toxin-filled seed pods into its hex. Armour is no help — the burst is a nerve gas, not a blow.

attacks.name: Poison gas pods
attacks.damage: 1d6-2 per pod, range 3 MH, ignores armour, hits all figures in target hex

fields.special_abilities: Weakness: Plant (+4 to hit, all facings count as rear); immune to arrows.; Source ST 6-10

fields.name: Giant Ant Lion
fields.description: A wagon-sized larva that digs a funnel of loose sand and waits at the bottom. Whatever slides in meets crushing mandibles and a digestive venom that works while the victim is still struggling.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; pit ambush.

fields.name: Army Ant
fields.description: A moving carpet of biting insects treated as a single figure. Blades pass straight through the swarm; the only answers are fire, water, or frantic stomping while the stings mount.

attacks.name: Sting
attacks.damage: 1d6-2; after the first hit the swarm is inside armour and stings each turn until removed

fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; swarm (weapons useless; stomp bare-handed).

fields.name: Fire Ant
fields.description: A red swarm whose stings burn out of all proportion to its size. Once it finds a gap in clothing it stays inside the armour, stinging every turn until the victim strips and sweeps it off.

attacks.name: Sting
attacks.damage: 1 hit; swarm stings inside armour each turn until removed

fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; swarm (weapons useless; 4/DX save after removing armour to dislodge).

fields.name: Black Giant Ant Worker
fields.description: The smallest caste of the black giant ants — a cat-sized forager that only fights when the nest is threatened. Alone it is a nuisance; a tunnel full of them is not.

fields.name: Black Giant Ant Scout
fields.description: A winged black giant ant that ranges ahead of the colony. Hard to swat in the air, it bites and flies home to fetch far worse company.

fields.name: Black Giant Ant Soldier
fields.description: A chitin-plated black giant ant bred for the colony's defence. Its bite shears flesh, and it never retreats while the nest stands.

fields.name: Black Giant Ant Warrior Drone
fields.description: The heaviest fighter of the black giant ants, all mandible and armour plate. It fights to the death wherever the queen's scent commands.

fields.name: Black Giant Ant Queen
fields.description: The bloated, immobile heart of a black giant ant colony. She cannot chase anyone, but every ant in the nest converges on whatever touches her.

fields.name: Brown Giant Ant Warrior Drone
fields.description: A yard-long fighting ant with jaws that punch through mail. It meets intruders head-on where its thick frontal chitin does the work.
fields.special_abilities: Chitin stops 4 hits if attacked from the front hex

fields.name: Brown Giant Ant Worker
fields.description: A dog-sized brown ant that would rather haul than fight — including hauling a downed enemy back to the nest as provisions. Being dragged off alive is the real danger.
fields.special_abilities: Drags downed foes toward the nest.; Chitin stops 1 hit

fields.name: Brown Giant Ant Queen
fields.description: The egg-laying giant at the centre of a brown ant colony, too vast to move. Killing her kills the colony, which is exactly why the colony will not let anyone near.

fields.name: Brown Giant Ant Scout
fields.description: A flying brown giant ant, quick and evasive on the wing. Its bite is modest; the soldiers it summons are not.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-4 to hit).; Chitin stops 1 hit; MA 8/20 (land/air)

fields.name: Brown Giant Ant Soldier
fields.description: A brown giant ant built for war, its head armoured like a shield boss. It holds tunnel mouths alone against armed parties.
fields.special_abilities: Chitin stops 3 hits if attacked from the front hex

fields.name: Red Giant Ant Warrior Drone
fields.description: A two-hex red ant the size of a pony, with a crushing bite and a venomous sting it swings into rear hexes or grapples. The most dangerous ant most people will ever see.
fields.special_abilities: Chitin stops 6 hits if attacked from the front hex

fields.name: Red Giant Ant Worker
fields.description: A two-hex red ant that forages in columns and takes livestock when it can. Even the labour caste of this species outmasses a warrior of most others.

fields.name: Red Giant Ant Queen
fields.description: A megahex-filling monster that founds and rules a red giant ant colony. She is a fortress of chitin surrounded by an army that dies for her gladly.

fields.name: Titanic Ant Scout
fields.description: A flying ant of the titanic breed, big as a dog and fast in the air. It exists to find prey and report it — being seen by one is the warning.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-4 to hit).; Chitin stops 2 hits; MA 10/24 (walking/flying)

fields.name: Titanic Ant Soldier
fields.description: A horse-sized ant with frontal armour like a wall and a venomous rear-facing sting. Spears bounce off the front; nothing safe faces the back.
fields.special_abilities: Chitin stops 5 hits if attacked from the front hex

fields.name: Apep
fields.description: An immense serpent wrapped in its own unnatural darkness, which spills a hex beyond its body and blinds everyone inside it. It strikes from the black where no one strikes back well.
fields.special_abilities: Aura of darkness (1-hex radius; -4 DX for figures in total darkness); elusive (-3 DX to hit).; Scales stop 3 hits

fields.name: Arachne
fields.description: A creature with a woman's shape above and a great spider's body below, hunting from webs strong enough to hold armoured prey. Cutting free takes strength most victims spend too late.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; web entangle (4/ST roll to break free).

fields.name: Archer Crab
fields.description: A tide-pool crab that shoots a jet of sticky goo with startling accuracy before closing with its claws. The goo blinds and mires; the claws finish.

fields.name: Bare Owl
fields.description: A featherless-necked owl of unsettling intelligence and macabre habits. It is a minor threat in a fight and a major one to anything small, sleeping, or wounded.

fields.name: Basilisk
fields.description: A squat, ugly lizard whose gaze carries a natural Freeze spell to five megahexes. The bite is an afterthought; the stare wins the fight before it starts.
fields.special_abilities: Natural Freeze spell (line of sight, range 5 MH, no ST cost, 4d/IQ to resist).

fields.name: Banshee
fields.description: A carnivorous bat named for its wail, all darting flight and needle teeth. It is nearly impossible to hit on the wing and hunts in shrieking flocks.

fields.name: Small Bat
fields.description: An ordinary insect-eating bat, dangerous to nothing bigger than a moth. It is listed because panicked people insist otherwise.

fields.name: Vampire Bat
fields.description: A blood-drinking bat that feeds on sleeping animals and the occasional sleeping person. The wound is trivial; what rides in the bite often is not.

fields.name: Flying Fox
fields.description: A fruit bat the size of a hawk, harmless unless cornered. Colonies roosting by the hundred can still empty an orchard overnight.

fields.name: Black Bear
fields.description: A forest bear that avoids people until food or cubs are involved. It hits with claw and jaw hard enough to end an argument in one exchange.

fields.name: Brown Bear (Exceptional Male)
fields.description: A grizzly of unusual size, the kind hunters tell stories about instead of hunting. Its reach, hide, and temper make it a match for armed parties.

fields.name: Drop Bear
fields.description: A compact ambush predator that waits on branches and falls onto prey claws-first. Its victims rarely hear anything before the impact.

fields.name: Giant Cave Bear
fields.description: A bear grown to fill the cave it claims, tall as two men at the shoulder when it rears. It treats intruding torchlight as a challenge.

fields.name: Polar Bear
fields.description: A white bear of the ice that stalks prey across open floes — including human prey, which it hunts without hesitation. Cold, patient, and enormous.

fields.name: Giant Beaver
fields.description: A beaver the size of a boar, placid until its dam or kits are touched. Its bite fells trees, and its tail-slap knocks grown men off their feet.

attacks.name: tail slap
attacks.damage: 1d6, rear hex, 3/DX save or knocked down, one attack per turn

fields.name: Bloodtree
fields.description: A carnivorous tree whose trailing vines snare passers-by, tangle their steps, and drain them where they stand. Rooted, but its reach is farther than it looks.
fields.special_abilities: Slows movement (2 MP per vine-covered hex); Weakness: Plant (+4 to hit, all facings count as rear).; Source ST 10/hex

fields.name: Giant Bombardier Beetle
fields.description: A cart-sized beetle that sprays a scalding chemical blast behind itself when threatened. Attacking from the rear is the classic mistake.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects.; Chitin stops 2 hits

fields.name: Bison
fields.description: A herd animal of the plains, placid at distance and an avalanche up close. A spooked herd is a natural disaster with hooves.

fields.name: Bonnacon
fields.description: A bull-like beast whose horns curl uselessly — its defence is a caustic spray from the other end that blisters everything in its wake as it flees.
fields.special_abilities: Caustic fecal spray (see below).; Hide stops 1 hit; Source ST 20-30

fields.name: Bull
fields.description: A domestic bull: heavy, territorial, and faster than it looks. The gore is the danger; the fence is the safety equipment.

fields.name: Cow
fields.description: A domestic cow, dangerous mostly by weight and panic. A kick from one still cracks bones.

fields.name: Ox
fields.description: A draught ox bred for pulling, patient beyond reason. When that patience runs out it gores and kicks with the mass of a laden wagon.

fields.name: Ruddy Bull
fields.description: A red-hided monster of a bull that kicks with both hind legs and can gore two attackers in one sweep of its horns. Bred for war as much as for show.

attacks.name: gore
attacks.damage: 2d6+2, any two figures in any front hex

fields.name: Camel
fields.description: A foul-tempered pack beast that bites at the front and kicks at everything else. Reliable in the desert, spiteful everywhere.

fields.name: Beggar
fields.description: A small scavenging canine that haunts camps and refuse heaps. It fights only when cornered, and badly.

fields.name: Chupacabra
fields.description: A hairless, hunched canine that drains the blood of penned livestock by night. It flees from people but leaves ugly work behind it.

fields.name: Coyote
fields.description: A lean opportunist canine, bolder than a fox and more patient than a wolf. Alone it takes vermin; in a pack it takes calves.

fields.name: Small Domestic Dog
fields.description: A lapdog or ratter. Its bite is trivial; its noise is the actual defence.

fields.name: Medium Hunting Dog
fields.description: A working hound bred to run down game and hold it at bay. A pack of them will hold a person just as readily.

fields.name: Large Guard Dog
fields.description: A heavy dog bred to stop intruders, with the jaw and nerve for the work. Trained pairs are worth more than a hired guard.

fields.name: Demon Dog
fields.description: A dog-shaped thing of ember and ash whose bite burns as it tears. Ordinary fur it has none; ordinary fear it causes plenty.

fields.name: Fox
fields.description: A small, clever canine that raids coops and traps. It is a threat to poultry and pride, nothing more.

fields.name: Dire Wolf
fields.description: A wolf half again the size it should be, with a bite to match. Packs of them empty valleys of livestock and worse.

fields.name: Gray Wolf
fields.description: The common wolf of forest and steppe, dangerous chiefly in numbers. A pack works a target with patience no single hunter can match.

fields.name: Jackal
fields.description: A scavenger canine that trails caravans and battles alike. It bites the fallen, not the standing.

fields.name: Cannon Flower
fields.description: A plant whose stalks fire hard seed tubes at anything moving within six megahexes. A stand of them holds a meadow like a battery holds a road.
fields.special_abilities: Weakness: Plant (+4 to hit, all facings count as rear); each stalk fires one seed tube per turn, range 6 MH (ranged attack).

fields.name: Catoblepas
fields.description: A heavy-bodied beast with a downcast head, an unnerving gaze that spoils attackers' aim, and breath that sickens at close range. It never hurries; it never needs to.
fields.special_abilities: Attackers are at -1 DX.; Hide stops 1 hit

fields.name: Chimera
fields.description: A fused horror of lion, goat, and serpent: claws and flame ahead, a venomous snake-headed tail behind, and a hide that shrugs at spells. There is no safe side to stand on.

attacks.name: snakebite
attacks.damage: 1d6-2, save at 3/ST or take 1d6 venom damage, rear hex only

fields.special_abilities: Magic resistance (-2 DX to all spells cast on it).; Hide stops 1 hit

fields.name: Cockatrice
fields.description: A rooster-shaped reptile whose touch brings on the paralytic wasting called the Little Death. Small, absurd, and rightly feared.

fields.name: Large Crabman
fields.description: The full-grown form of the crab-folk, shell like plate and pincers that crack bone. Voiceless, it clicks its claws in warning exactly once.

fields.name: Medium Crabman
fields.description: A crabman not yet at full growth, already armoured and strong. They forage in groups, which is the problem.

fields.name: Small Crabman
fields.description: A newly land-worthy crabman, more shell than threat. It pinches hard and retreats to the water.

fields.name: Monster Alligator
fields.description: An alligator grown far past any natural span, capable of dragging a horse under. The death roll is not survivable without help.
fields.special_abilities: Underwater concealment (-2 IQ to notice if submerged).; Bony plates stop 4 hits; Source ST 40-60

fields.name: Common Alligator
fields.description: A river alligator that lies invisible at the waterline. It takes prey at the bank and rolls it under.
fields.special_abilities: Underwater concealment (-2 IQ to notice if submerged).; Bony plates stop 3 hits; Source ST 18-20

fields.name: Common Crocodile
fields.description: A crocodile of river and marsh that bites, drags under, and sweeps its tail through anything standing behind it. The bank is its trap, not its territory's edge.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.damage: 2d6, one target in front hex only, attempt to drag underwater next turn; tail (all targets in rear hex, 3/DX to avoid being knocked down); underwater death roll (3/ST to get free

fields.special_abilities: Underwater concealment (-2 IQ to see if submerged).; Bony plates stop 3 hits

fields.name: Saltwater Crocodile
fields.description: The largest true crocodile, at home in surf and estuary. It hits like a gate slamming and takes the victim to deep water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.damage: 2d6+3, one target in front hex only, attempt to drag underwater next turn

attacks.name: tail
attacks.damage: all targets in rear hex, 3/DX to avoid being knocked down, underwater death roll (4/ST to get free)

fields.special_abilities: Underwater concealment (-2 IQ to see if submerged).; Bony plates stop 3 hits

fields.name: Common Small Deer
fields.description: A light deer of wood and field, defenceless except in flight. Its kick is a startled reflex, not a strategy.

fields.name: Common Large Deer
fields.description: A full-sized stag or elk. Outside the rut it flees; inside the rut it is an antlered lunatic with hooves.

fields.name: Giant Deer
fields.description: A deer the size of a draught horse, crowned with antlers wider than a door. Even predators wait for winter to weaken it first.

fields.name: Diatryma
fields.description: A flightless bird taller than a rider, with a beak like a pickaxe and a kick to match — and it can use both in the same turn. Fast, aggressive, and unbothered by spears.
fields.special_abilities: Can use both attacks in one turn (at ‑4 DX for each).; Source ST 22-24

fields.name: Dipsa
fields.description: A slime-covered snake so thin and pale it is nearly invisible, whose bite goes unnoticed until the venom lands a day's march later. The kill arrives before the diagnosis.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: 3d6 in the second turn after envenomation

fields.special_abilities: Hard to spot (-4 to hit; -2 IQ to notice).

fields.name: Dragon Hatchling
fields.description: A dragon fresh from the shell, all instinct and sparks. Its flame is a candle next to its parents' — which is the thing to remember about where its parents are.

fields.name: Baby Dragon
fields.description: A dragon the size of a hound, already breathing usable fire. Bold, clumsy, and lethal to anything that underestimates the fire.

fields.name: Young Dragon
fields.description: A dragon at the awkward stage: big as a horse, flame that sets thatch alight, and judgement not yet grown into. The most reckless age of a very dangerous species.

fields.name: Adult Dragon
fields.description: A full dragon — sixty men's strength, a scholar's mind, wings, and a furnace throat that costs it real effort and repays the cost in ash. Negotiation is usually cheaper.

fields.name: Elder Dragon
fields.description: A dragon aged into something closer to geography than beast. Its flame unmakes buildings, its scales turn siege bolts, and its patience is the only reason anything nearby survives.

fields.name: Young Adult Dragon
fields.description: A dragon newly come into full flight and serious fire, eager to establish a territory. The eagerness is what makes it more dangerous than its elders.

fields.name: Dragonet
fields.description: A cat-sized dragon-relative that hoards shiny trinkets and spits stubby flames. Hard to catch, harder to convince to leave.

fields.name: Air Elemental
fields.description: A bound whirl of living wind that batters, deafens, and hurls debris. It has no body to cut — only weather to endure.

fields.name: Stone Elemental
fields.description: Animate rock in a walking shape, slow and inevitable. Its embrace cracks ribs like kindling, and blades ring off it uselessly.

fields.name: Common Earth Elemental
fields.description: A shambling mass of living soil and root. It smothers and crushes with the patience of the ground itself.

fields.name: Fire Elemental
fields.description: A striding bonfire that seeds fire hexes as it moves and flings fireballs from its own substance. Water is its only real argument.
fields.special_abilities: Creates fire hex (3 MA spent in a hex; burns 12 turns); fireballs (1 ST each, 1d-1); weapon resistance; Weakness: water (a quart thrown causes 1d; a rainstorm 4d per turn).; Source ST ±14

fields.name: Metal Elemental
fields.description: The rarest and most vicious elemental, a moving mass of living metal. Its blows land like forge hammers and almost nothing marks it.

fields.name: Ice Form
fields.description: A water elemental frozen into jagged, walking ice. Only magic weapons bite it at all, and those only half as deep.

fields.name: Steam Form
fields.description: A water elemental boiled into scalding vapour. Armour holds the heat out for one turn, then cooks what it was protecting.

attacks.name: Live steam
attacks.damage: 1d6 HTH, armor protects for only one turn

fields.special_abilities: Affected only by magic weapons, which do only half damage.; MA 10/16 (land/water); Source ST ±14

fields.name: Water Form
fields.description: A water elemental in its liquid shape, which flows over anyone standing in its element and drowns them there. On dry land it is merely patient.

attacks.name: Engulf
attacks.damage: only against victims standing in at least a foot of water

fields.special_abilities: Affected only by magic weapons, which do only half damage.; MA 10/16 (land/water); Source ST ±14

fields.name: Donkey
fields.description: A stubborn small equine, more likely to plant its feet than fight. Its kick is a mule's lesson in miniature.

fields.name: Light Horse
fields.description: A swift saddle horse bred for speed over burden. It fights only by accident, at the end of a panicked run.

fields.name: Pony
fields.description: A compact, hardy horse for hills and children. Sure-footed, stubborn, and startlingly strong for its size.

fields.name: Common Horse
fields.description: The everyday working horse of farm and road. Its dangers are a rear hoof and its own panic.

fields.name: Riding Horse
fields.description: A trained saddle mount with manners and stamina. It kicks and tramples only when its rider or its nerves fail.

fields.name: Draft Horse
fields.description: A massive harness horse that moves loads smaller beasts cannot. Its kick carries all of that mass.

fields.name: Warhorse
fields.description: A horse trained to fight — biting, kicking, and trampling in the same turn on command. Half the value of a mounted knight is under the saddle.
fields.special_abilities: May kick and bite in the same turn at ‑4 DX.; Source ST 24+

fields.name: Pegasus
fields.description: A winged horse, shy of bridles and rare as honesty. It fights like a horse and escapes like a bird.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-1 to hit).; MA 22/30 (land/air); Source ST 20-24

fields.name: Mule
fields.description: The working cross of horse and donkey: stronger than either's temper deserves. It kicks with deliberation, not panic.

fields.name: Unicorn
fields.description: A horned horse of deep woodland, fierce, fast, and impossible to tame by force. The horn hits hardest at the end of a charge.

fields.name: Zebra
fields.description: A striped wild equine that never accepted the saddle. It bites and kicks with a wild horse's full commitment.

fields.name: Domestic Cat
fields.description: A house cat. It cannot hurt an armoured person and will not accept that premise.

fields.name: Cougar
fields.description: A solitary ambush cat of crag and forest that drops on prey from above. Its grapple turns a bad first second into a worse rest of the fight.

fields.name: Jaguar
fields.description: A heavy jungle cat that kills with a skull bite and swims willingly after prey. In its wet, dark country it chooses every engagement.

fields.name: Lion
fields.description: The great social cat of the plains — the pride hunts as a unit and shares the arithmetic between claws and jaws. Lone travellers are exactly the sum it prefers.

fields.name: Sabertooth
fields.description: A shock-predator cat built around two dagger fangs, made to drag down beasts far bigger than itself. It grapples, anchors, and drives the fangs home.

fields.name: Tiger
fields.description: The largest of the striped cats, a solitary stalker of dense cover. It is faster and closer than anyone in its territory believes until proven.

fields.name: Florasting
fields.description: A hand-sized flying plant-thing armed with a venomous thorn, absurdly hard to swat. One is a curiosity; the cloud it belongs to is a hazard.
fields.special_abilities: As an individual, a hard target (-5 to hit).; Source ST 10*

fields.name: Florawing
fields.description: A drifting cloud of ten or fifteen florastings moving as one. It settles over prey like weather and stings it into flight or collapse.
fields.special_abilities: As Florasting; collective entry for a cloud of 10-15.; Source ST 10*

fields.name: Flying Head
fields.description: A glowing orange orb of a head that flies, grins, and lashes out with a barbed tongue. It bursts like a lanced boil at any solid blow — getting that blow in is the trick.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-4 to hit); Weakness: destroyed by any single hit of 5+.; Source ST 10-16

fields.name: Forest Star
fields.description: A star-shaped floor growth that fastens onto whatever steps on it and chews. It cannot chase, which is little comfort to the foot it has.

fields.name: Giant Bullfrog (1-hex)
fields.description: A frog the size of a hunting dog that hauls wading prey under the surface. The bite is weak; the drowning is not.

fields.name: Bullfrog
fields.description: A common pond bullfrog. Its only weapon is its dinner-bell croak, listed here for completeness.

fields.name: Giant Bullfrog (3-hex)
fields.description: A frog spanning three hexes, patient as the pond it rules. It swallows waterfowl whole and drags larger meals under to soften.

fields.name: Giant Pacman Frog
fields.description: A burrow-mouthed frog that is mostly an enormous hinged jaw. It engulfs prey in one gulp and works it down bite by bite.

fields.name: Ghoul
fields.description: A grave-haunting humanoid that eats the dead and sees perfectly in the dark. It fights with claws or scavenged weapons and prefers its meals unresisting.

fields.name: Juvenile Gitaskog
fields.description: A young lake-serpent already longer than a canoe. It tests boats the way pups test shoes.

fields.name: Adult Gitaskog
fields.description: A full-grown lake-serpent of enormous strength that swamps boats and takes swimmers. Deep water is its country, and it patrols.

fields.name: Glyptodont
fields.description: A living dome of bony plate on four legs, with a knobbed tail that swings like a mace at anything behind it. Cracking it open is siege work.

fields.name: Clay Golem
fields.description: A man-shape of raw clay animated to serve, wrapped in a magic that slides the eye past it. Its fists land with the weight of the riverbank it came from.
fields.special_abilities: Unnoticeability aura (as the spell).; Soft clay stops 3 hits; Source ST 50-100

fields.name: Golem Hound
fields.description: A fired-clay hound animated as a tireless sentry. It does not eat, sleep, or bluff.
fields.special_abilities: Fired clay stops 4 hits; Source ST 32-40

fields.name: Parchment Golem
fields.description: A servant folded from written pages that slices with paper edges and wraps around foes like a living rope, knitting itself as it fights. Fire reads it a final time.
fields.special_abilities: Regenerates 1/turn; binds opponents (as Giant Rope); Weakness: triple damage from fire.; Source ST 5-20

fields.name: Metal Golem
fields.description: A towering figure of animate metal whose grip sears as it crushes. Short of a forge or a mountain, very little argues with it.
fields.special_abilities: Can burn grappled targets with heat (extra 1d damage).; Metal stops 5 hits; Source ST 60-120

fields.name: Wood Golem
fields.description: A walking timber servant that senses living things across a wide radius and regrows any wound left unfinished. It floats, it patrols, and it burns — eventually.
fields.special_abilities: Regrows unless destroyed; senses life (as Detect Life / Detect Enemies, 20 MH); floats; Weakness: double damage from fire.; Wood stops 2 hits; Source ST 25-50

fields.name: Stone Golem
fields.description: A granite figure animated for guardianship, sometimes carrying its maker's sight within it. It does not tire and does not miss its watch.
fields.special_abilities: Can function as a Proxy for its creator.; Stone stops 4 hits; Source ST 50-100

fields.name: Gryphon
fields.description: An eagle-lion that stoops from altitude onto horse-sized prey, striking beak, claw, and pounce together. It defends its high nest with all four of those things.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-1 to hit).; Hide stops 1 hit; MA 14/24 land; Source ST 26-32

fields.name: Harpy
fields.description: A winged creature with a hag's face and a raptor's talons, filthy in habit and voice. It snatches, fouls, and screams — usually in that order.

fields.name: Head Fly
fields.description: A fly the size of a fist that goes for the face and will not be waved off. It cannot kill; it has ruined many people's aim at the worst moment.
fields.special_abilities: Tiny (-1 to hit); flight (-4 to hit).

fields.name: Headless Man
fields.description: A shambling human figure with no head at all, sensing the world in some other way — poorly, at its edges. What it wants is unclear, which is most of the horror.
fields.special_abilities: Weakness: limited peripheral vision.; Source ST 10-18

fields.name: Hippogriff
fields.description: A crossed eagle-and-horse that flies with a raptor's temper and kicks with a horse's legs. It is tameable, barely, by the patient and the well-armoured.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-1 to hit).; MA 20/30 land; Source ST 18-22

fields.name: Large Hydra
fields.description: The elder growth of hydra, a rampart of necks and appetite. Each head strikes on its own, and the beast thinks better than anything with that many mouths should.

fields.name: Hydra
fields.description: A many-headed reptile that bites with every head in a single turn and speaks when it prefers cruelty with words. There is no flank where a head is not.

fields.name: Hydret
fields.description: The hydra's smaller three-headed cousin, necks weaving so wide its sides count as front. It is a hydra's danger at a market-fair size.
fields.special_abilities: Both side hexes count as front.; Scales stop 1 hit

fields.name: Hyena
fields.description: A heavy-jawed pack scavenger that laughs while it works and hunts when scavenging is slow. Its bite cracks bones the big cats leave behind.

fields.name: Ichneumon
fields.description: A mongoose grown to six feet and utterly immune to venom and toxin — the fabled dragon-bane. It kills serpents of every size on principle.
fields.special_abilities: Immune to toxins.; Fur stops 1 hit

fields.name: Giant Jackalope
fields.description: An antlered hare the size of a ram, absurd right up until the gore. It charges without warning and bounds away before the reply.

fields.name: Fangaroo
fields.description: A kangaroo-shaped predator with a carnivore's fangs where no fangs belong. It bounds in, bites deep, and is gone.

fields.name: Miniature Kangaroo
fields.description: A knee-high kangaroo of scrubland and burrow. Its kick is a warning, not a weapon.

fields.name: Small Kangaroo (Wallaby)
fields.description: A wallaby — compact, quick, and inclined to leave. Cornered, it kicks harder than its size suggests.

fields.name: Medium Kangaroo
fields.description: A grown kangaroo that boxes and kicks when pressed. The tail-braced double kick has broken hunters' ribs.

fields.name: Large Kangaroo
fields.description: A man-tall kangaroo whose braced kick lands like a club swing. It will stand its ground and use it.

fields.name: Kingowing
fields.description: A crowned flying beast that rakes with claws and drives its head like a hammer, both in one pass. It rules whatever cliff it nests on.
fields.special_abilities: Can perform two attacks on the same target at -4 DX; flight (-4 to hit).; Furred hide stops 1 hit; MA 8/16 (land/air)

fields.name: Kraken
fields.description: A ship-sized horror of tentacles and beak that takes vessels the way an octopus takes crabs. Every arm hunts on its own; the beak waits at the centre.
fields.special_abilities: Multiple simultaneous tentacle attacks.; Shell stops 6 hits; Source ST 60+

fields.name: Common Leech
fields.description: A swamp leech that fastens on unnoticed and drinks. Blunt force cannot harm what has no bones to break — salt and flame do.
fields.special_abilities: Cannot be harmed by blunt weapons, fists, etc.; tiny (-1 to hit).

fields.name: Giant Leech
fields.description: A leech the length of an arm that drains fast enough to stagger a grown man. It drops from reeds and overhangs onto warmth.
fields.special_abilities: Cannot be harmed by blunt weapons, fists, etc.; MA 1/4 (land/water)

fields.name: Komodo Dragon
fields.description: A monitor lizard heavy as a man, with a septic, venomous bite. It follows wounded prey for days with total confidence.
fields.special_abilities: Venom (see below).; Scales stop 1 hit; Source ST 12-16

fields.name: Giant Monitor
fields.description: A monitor lizard grown to horse length, sweeping its tail through legs and biting what falls. Its patience is reptile-cold.
fields.special_abilities: Tail sweep (see below); venom (see below).; Scales stop 1 hit; Source ST 20-24

fields.name: Riding Lizard
fields.description: A lizard bred and saddled as a mount in hot country. It is steady under a rider and still entirely willing to bite.
fields.special_abilities: Tail sweep (see below).; Scales stop 2 hits; Source ST 20-30

fields.name: Saurian
fields.description: A towering reptile of the deep wilds, a predator by mass alone. It walks through underbrush the way floods walk through fences.

fields.name: Walker Lizard
fields.description: A tall, striding lizard that runs down prey on two legs. It bites and kicks at speed and rarely commits to a long fight.

fields.name: Long Lankin
fields.description: A gaunt nine-foot figure that sees in the dark, sees the invisible, and cannot be fooled by illusion. Its long claws come through windows left open at night.
fields.special_abilities: Sees in darkness; sees the invisible; cannot perceive illusions.; Hide stops 2 hits

fields.name: Mana Sponge
fields.description: A drab, pulsing growth that drinks the magic out of the air — and out of spells, and out of wizards. It threatens no one and ruins everything.

fields.name: Mandrake
fields.description: A rooted plant whose man-shaped root screams when pulled, a sound that can stop a heart. Harvesting it is a profession with a short life expectancy.
fields.special_abilities: Scream (see below); Weakness: Plant (+4 to hit).

fields.name: Common Man o’ War
fields.description: A drifting colony creature trailing curtains of stinging tentacles, blind to everything around it. It cannot aim, and does not need to.
fields.special_abilities: Sting (tentacle contact); cannot sense attackers, so all hexes count as rear.

fields.name: Vampire Man o’ War
fields.description: A floating stinger-colony that drifts deliberately toward warmth and treats every direction as its front. Its tentacles drain as well as burn.
fields.special_abilities: Sting (tentacle contact); all hexes count as front.

fields.name: Manticore
fields.description: A lion-bodied creature with a man's face, a venomous sting, and a talent for mimicking voices to bait its ambushes. The voice calling for help is the trap.
fields.special_abilities: Mimic talent (lures victims).; Hide stops 2 hits; Source ST 22-30

fields.name: Mauler
fields.description: A squat horror that punches twice a turn and watches every direction at once. Its single great eye is the one soft thing on it.
fields.special_abilities: All hexes count as front; Weakness: vulnerable eye (see source, p. 111).

fields.name: Minipus
fields.description: A hand-sized land octopus that swarms over a victim and clings. One is harmless; a wave of them is a smothering tide.

fields.name: Moa
fields.description: A flightless bird taller than a man, all leg and temper. Its kick and stabbing beak see off most predators — and most collectors.

fields.name: Monopod
fields.description: A one-legged humanoid that travels in prodigious bounces and lands, deliberately, on people. Between bounces it is oddly difficult to hurt.

fields.name: Mothman
fields.description: A silent, man-tall figure with vast black wings, seen near bridges and disasters. Whether it causes the calamity or merely attends it is the argument; the talons are not.
fields.special_abilities: Silent movement; flight (-4 to hit).; Thick plumage stops 1 hit; MA 8/16 (land/air)

fields.name: Baby Myrmecoleon
fields.description: The larval stage of the ant-lion beast, a finger-length stinger in loose soil. Its danger is being one of hundreds.

fields.name: 6-inch Myrmecoleon
fields.description: A myrmecoleon at its second growth, sting outpacing size. It hunts from a thumb-deep pit.

fields.name: 2-foot Myrmecoleon
fields.description: A myrmecoleon grown to terrier size, biting and stinging in the same rush. Fields with their pits go unploughed.

fields.name: 4-foot Myrmecoleon
fields.description: A myrmecoleon at its adolescent bulk, quick and armoured in patches. It takes goats, dogs, and the unwary shepherd's leg.

fields.name: 8-foot Myrmecoleon
fields.description: The full-grown myrmecoleon, a lion-sized thing of mandible and sting. Its pit can swallow a rider, mount and all.
fields.special_abilities: Hide or chitin stops 1 hit; Source ST 24-28

fields.name: Ness
fields.description: A long-necked lake beast that surfaces like a moving island, able to stretch its bite two hexes past its body. It is shy, until boats press the question.
fields.special_abilities: Distant neck attack (bite up to 2 hexes away in a line from any front hex).; Hide stops 2 hits; MA 4/12 (land/water); Source ST 50-60

fields.name: Octopus
fields.description: A soft-bodied sea hunter clever enough to wield three weapons at once in its arms. It camouflages, jets away, and remembers grudges.
fields.special_abilities: Camouflage and other tricks (see source, p. 119); can wield up to three one-hand weapons or shields at once with no DX penalty.; Skin stops 2 hits

fields.name: Olgoi-khorkhoi
fields.description: A fat red desert worm that kills with a jolt like a lightning spell, spits burning saliva, and bites what survives. The sands above its burrow look like all the other sands.
fields.special_abilities: Shock Shield attack (as the spell).; MA 4/8 (underground/surface)

fields.name: Ostrich
fields.description: A tall flightless bird, fast as a horse and armed with a disemboweling kick. It does not want a fight; it finishes the ones offered.

fields.name: Elephant
fields.description: A grey colossus that reaches two hexes with its trunk and flattens what closes to one. Calm by preference, unstoppable by construction.

fields.name: Hippopotamus
fields.description: A river beast whose yawning bite crushes canoes and whose temper needs no provocation at all. It kills more travellers than any local predator.
fields.special_abilities: Reaction adjustment -2.; Hide stops 2 hits; Source ST 30-45

fields.name: Indricotherium
fields.description: The largest walking beast known — a hornless rhinoceros tall as a watchtower. It fights nothing; it simply fails to notice what it destroys.

fields.name: Mammoth
fields.description: A woolly cold-country elephant with sweeping tusks and a shaggy hide like a wall hanging. Herds break through snow, fences, and battle lines with equal ease.
fields.special_abilities: Furred hide stops 3 hits; Source ST 60-90

fields.name: Pygmy Mammoth
fields.description: An island-bred mammoth the size of a big ox, wool and tusks in miniature. Herds of them are stubborn, not tame.

fields.name: Rhinoceros
fields.description: A horned tank of a beast with poor eyesight and total commitment. It charges first and never asks the question the charge answered.
fields.special_abilities: Reaction adjustment -2.; Hide stops 2 hits; Source ST 35-60

fields.name: Greater Parrot
fields.description: A large, sharp-witted parrot that mimics speech well enough to deceive and works simple latches with its beak. Its owners rarely know what it has repeated, or to whom.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-4 to hit); mimics speech; can work simple mechanisms.; MA 2/16 (land/air)

fields.name: Lesser Parrot
fields.description: A small trainable parrot of bright feather and modest wit. Its bite is a pinch; its screech carries for miles.

attacks.name: Negligible in most cases, but see Piranhakeet

fields.name: Phoenix
fields.description: A firebird that dies in flame and returns from its own ash. Fighting one is not dangerous so much as pointless.

fields.name: Piranhakeet
fields.description: A tiny parrot with a shark's appetite, dangerous only — and entirely — as a flock. A cloud of them strips a mule in minutes.
fields.special_abilities: Hard target (-4 to hit while flying).; MA 2/20 (walking/flying)

fields.name: Pit Trap Plant
fields.description: A pit lined with the plant's own digestive throat, roofed with false ground. Falling in is survivable; the hours afterward are the weapon.
fields.special_abilities: Weakness: Plant: (+4 to hit, all facings R).

fields.name: Plocker
fields.description: A round, furred forest animal kept sometimes as a pet. It bites gently and threatens nothing but rations.

fields.name: Giant Praying Mantis
fields.description: A mantis at horse scale with a strike quicker than a fencer's lunge. It holds perfectly still in the green until the reach is right.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects.; Chitin stops 1 hit; Source ST 20-30

fields.name: Common Rat
fields.description: The wharf and cellar rat. One is nothing; the swarm behind the wall is the actual tenant.

fields.name: Giant Rat
fields.description: A rat grown to spaniel size, bold in packs and foul of bite. Sewers and sieges breed them in numbers.

fields.name: Common Roc
fields.description: A raptor vast enough to carry off livestock, riding thermals no arrow reaches. Its stoop hits like falling masonry.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-1 to hit).; MA 8/30 (land/air); Source ST 30-50

fields.name: Giant Roc
fields.description: A roc from which legends are correctly told — a bird that takes elephants as an eagle takes hares. Its wingbeats flatten camps; its attention flattens everything else.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-1 to hit).; MA 8/60+ (land/air); Source ST 150+

fields.name: Viridian Roc
fields.description: A green-plumed roc of forested country, smaller than its giant kin and far more inclined to hunt people. In the canopy it is nearly invisible.

fields.name: Scavenger Scarab
fields.description: A heavy carrion beetle that swarms battlefields and boneyards. It prefers its meals still, and helps them get that way when pressed.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects.; Chitin stops 1 hit

fields.name: Small Scolopendra
fields.description: A venomous centipede the length of a forearm, all speed and irritable fangs. Its bite burns for hours past the danger.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: 1d6 per turn until victim saves at 3/ST

fields.name: Large Scolopendra
fields.description: A centipede at dog length whose venom leaves victims shaking with pain for hours. It flows over ground, wall, and ceiling at the same speed.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: 1d6 per turn until victim saves at 3/ST; ‑2 DX because of intense pain for 2 hours after bite

fields.name: Giant Scolopendra
fields.description: A centipede long as a wagon, striking from burrows with paired venomous fangs. Its bite drops livestock; the pain drops the rescuers' aim.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: 1d6 per turn until save at 3/ ST; ‑2 DX because of intense pain for 2 hours after bite

fields.name: Common Scorpion
fields.description: A palm-sized scorpion whose sting slips through boot seams as if armour were a suggestion. Painful always, lethal occasionally.

attacks.name: Sting
attacks.damage: 1 hit, ignores up to 3 points of armour

fields.name: Large Scorpion
fields.description: A scorpion at cat size with venom to match. It rattles its claws in warning exactly once.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 4d6/ST or take additional 2d6-1 damage

fields.name: Giant Scorpion
fields.description: A scorpion the size of a pony: crushing claws forward, a killing sting arched overhead. The desert's most honest ambush.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 4d6/ST or take additional 2d6 damage

fields.name: Scum Bunny
fields.description: A pond-scummed little beast that lurks camouflaged at the waterline. It bites ankles and vanishes into the murk.

fields.name: Scuttle
fields.description: A skittering blood-drinking vermin that slips into bedding and boots. Small enough to ignore, which is how it feeds.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; bloodsucking (see below); tiny (-1 to hit).; MA 4/6 (land/water)

fields.name: Juvenile Sea Scorpion
fields.description: A young sea scorpion, already armoured and armed at the size of a hound. Shallow-water waders find them the hard way.
fields.special_abilities: Exoskeleton stops 2 hits; MA 12 (water); Source ST 6-12

fields.name: Adult Sea Scorpion
fields.description: A full-grown armoured sea scorpion that pins prey with its claws and shears it with its mouthparts. It rules the shallows it patrols.
fields.special_abilities: Exoskeleton stops 2 hits; MA 12 (water); Source ST 18-22

fields.name: Small Shadow Shark
fields.description: A shark-shaped shadow that swims through the air and bites away vigour rather than flesh. Blades find nothing in it to cut.

fields.name: Medium Shadow Shark
fields.description: A grown shadow shark, circling the tired and the wounded. Each pass drains strength the victim cannot see leaving.

fields.name: Large Shadow Shark
fields.description: The largest of the shadow sharks, a darkness with a fin. It exhausts strong men to collapse in a handful of passes.

fields.name: Shadow Skate
fields.description: A small drifting shadow-creature, a skate-shaped patch of dark. It is less a fighter than a symptom that worse shadows are near.

fields.name: Shadow Ray
fields.description: A winged shadow with a whip tail that stings deep. It glides silent along walls and ceilings where torchlight fails.

fields.name: Baboon
fields.description: A dog-faced monkey that troops in disciplined bands and fights with slashing canines. The troop's males counterattack together, and hold grudges.

fields.name: Chimpanzee
fields.description: An ape of unsettling strength for its size, clever with tools and terrible in anger. Its grappling bite ends fights its screaming starts.

fields.name: Gorilla
fields.description: A great ape of highland forest, peaceable and immensely strong. Threat displays are a courtesy; the follow-through is not.

fields.name: Great Ape
fields.description: An ape beyond gorilla size, a hill of muscle with hands. Its open-handed blow lands like a beam falling.

fields.name: Monkey
fields.description: A quick, thieving monkey of canopy and rooftop. It bites when caught, which it rarely is.
fields.special_abilities: Elusive (-3 to hit); Naturalist talent.; Source ST 2-6

fields.name: Ourang-Au-Tan
fields.description: A red-furred forest ape of deep, deliberate intelligence that trades gifts and keeps its own counsel. It fights rarely, reluctantly, and well.
fields.special_abilities: Naturalist talent (elder has the Master Naturalist talent).; MA 4/10 (ground/trees); Source ST 12-16

fields.name: Sinstoner
fields.description: A vulture-sized corvid that carries a smooth stone aloft and drops it on prey with bombardier precision. Then it lands to peck through the results.

fields.name: Brown Slime
fields.description: A creeping brown ooze that smothers and slowly corrodes, indifferent to blades, bolts, and fire alike. Bare hands or strong acid — those are the options.
fields.special_abilities: Immune to fire and to all physical attacks except bare-handed tearing; Weakness: common slime weaknesses plus acid.

fields.name: Silver Slime
fields.description: A gleaming ooze that discharges a lightning jolt into whatever touches it. Only fire, acid, or explosion mark it at all.
fields.special_abilities: Lightning attack; partial physical im- munity (immune to any physical attack or interaction except fire, acid, or explosions, which do normal damage).; Source ST 12-20

fields.name: Green Slime
fields.description: A green ceiling-ooze that ignores ordinary weapons entirely. Fire burns it out — fire is the whole plan.
fields.special_abilities: Immune to normal attacks; Weakness: Takes double damage from fire.; Source ST 12-20

fields.name: Red Slime
fields.description: A rust-coloured ooze that shrugs off fire, heat, and cold, and eats metal to ruin in a minute's contact. Swords are both useless and consumed.
fields.special_abilities: Immune to fire, heat, and cold; corrodes metal to uselessness in about a minute of contact.; Source ST 12-20

fields.name: Slinker
fields.description: A rat-monkey shape that flows through shadows with a thief's talent for not being seen. It steals food, shiny things, and sleep.

fields.name: Common Constrictor
fields.description: A modest constrictor snake that squeezes what it bites. It is a danger to poultry and to people who reach into the wrong hollow.
fields.special_abilities: Constriction; elusive (-3 DX to hit; side hexes count as front).

fields.name: Large Constrictor
fields.description: A python-class constrictor heavy enough to take a goat — or pin a person's arms while it works. Its coils tighten with every exhale.

fields.name: Giant Constrictor
fields.description: A serpent thick as a barrel that crushes armoured men, mail and all. Once the coils close, the fight is arithmetic.

fields.name: Venomous Snake
fields.description: A snake whose bite barely marks the skin and does not need to. The venom does the killing on its own schedule.
fields.special_abilities: Venom on bite; elusive (-3 to hit).; Source ST 1-6

fields.name: Giant Snapping Turtle
fields.description: A snapper broad as a cart, with a beak that shears oars and hands alike. It waits buried in pond-mud with geological patience.

fields.name: Monstrous Snapping Turtle
fields.description: A snapping turtle mistaken, credibly, for an island. Its shell turns siege weapons and its bite dismantles boats.
fields.special_abilities: Shell stops 7 hits; MA 4/12 (land/water); Source ST 70+

fields.name: Sphinx
fields.description: A winged lion with a woman's face, learned, magical, and fond of fatal riddles. Its claws are the answer to answering badly.
fields.special_abilities: Talents and magical abilities (see source, p. 165).; Hide stops 1 hit; MA 12/26 land; Source ST 20-26

fields.name: Small Gate Spider
fields.description: A hand-sized spider that weaves true magical gates into its webs and hunts through them. The web across the path connects to somewhere much worse.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 3/ST or take additional 1d6 damage

fields.name: Large Gate Spider
fields.description: A gate spider at three feet of body, portalling between its woven doorways to strike from behind. Its lair is everywhere its webs are.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 4/ST or take additional 1d6+2 hits of damage

fields.name: Giant Spider (Baby)
fields.description: A giant spider at foot-long size, venom already outrunning light armour. Nests hold dozens at this stage.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: successful bite penetrates any armor that stops only 1 hit; save at 3/ST or take an additional 1d6+1 hits

fields.name: Giant Spider (Adult)
fields.description: A spider with a six-foot body whose bite slips through most armour and whose venom does the rest. Its silk holds warhorses.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: successful bite penetrates any armor that stops 2 hits or less; save at 4/ST or take an additional 2d6 hits

fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects.; Source ST 16+

fields.name: Venomous Spider
fields.description: A small spider whose entire threat is chemical. It gets inside armour, bites once, and the day changes.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 3/ST or take an additional 2d6-5 hits

fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; armor penetration (save at 3/ DX or one or more spiders get inside).

fields.name: Stone Beetle
fields.description: A beetle armoured in what is functionally masonry. Cracking that carapace takes heavy tools and more time than its bite allows.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects.; Stone carapace stops 5 hits

fields.name: Stonemason
fields.description: A small insect that chews building stone into meals and tunnels. It endangers no one directly — except everyone in the building above.

fields.name: Domestic or Feral Pig
fields.description: A farm pig or its feral cousin — heavier, faster, and meaner than town folk expect. The tusked feral gores; the tuskless one still flattens.

attacks.name: Gore
attacks.damage: 1d6+2, or 1d6-1 for a tuskless domestic pig

fields.name: Wild Boar
fields.description: A bristled forest boar that charges when wounded, cornered, or insufficiently entertained. Its gore opens legs like a plough opens turf.

fields.name: Swordbird
fields.description: A bird whose metallic feathers cut, stab, and — flung in fans of three — fly six hexes as blades. It is an armoury with wings and a grudge.
fields.special_abilities: Flight (-4 to hit).; Metallic feathers stop 1 hit; MA 4/20 land

fields.name: Tatzelwurm
fields.description: A cat-faced alpine serpent that spits venom the length of a rope toss and bites with a venomed backup. Mountain folk wall their windows against it.

fields.name: Tepes Briar
fields.description: A briar hedge that grows explosive, poison-seeded melons and detonates them at passers-by. The hedge looks exactly like the safe kind.
fields.special_abilities: Weakness: Plant (+4 to hit; all hexes are R).

fields.name: Troll
fields.description: A huge, misshapen humanoid that regenerates every wound as fast as it takes them — save burns. Without fire the fight simply starts over each turn.
fields.special_abilities: Regenerates all damage except fire, 1 ST per turn.; Source ST 30-60

fields.name: Uncle Teeth
fields.description: A long-necked river horror that strikes three hexes past its body, from any front hex, without warning. The name is the local joke; the empty fishing spots are not.
fields.special_abilities: Distant neck attack (bite up to 3 hexes away in a line from any front hex).; Scaled hide stops 2 hits; Source ST 50-60

fields.name: Vitranth
fields.description: A living crystal formation with no front, no back, and spines in every direction. It does not chase; it is simply, painfully, where you put your hand.
fields.special_abilities: All hexes are front hexes.; Crystal stops 3 hits; Source ST 12-16

fields.name: Wampus Cat
fields.description: A six-legged panther-thing that grapples with its forepaws and brings the remaining legs, tail, and teeth into the same turn. Escaping the grapple is the whole fight.
fields.special_abilities: HTH grapple with forepaws, then attacks with remaining legs, tail, and teeth in the same turn; tail can strike rear hexes.; Fur stops 1 hit; Source ST 20-24

fields.name: Berserker Wasp
fields.description: A wasp that attacks anything moving in its territory, alone or in maddened dozens. Too small to hit, too angry to wait out.
fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; tiny and elusive (-5 to hit).

fields.name: Common Wasp
fields.description: An ordinary stinging wasp. The sting is trivial unless the victim's blood disagrees — or the nest empties.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: 3/ST save per hit or take additional venom damage

fields.name: Giant Wasp
fields.description: A wasp the size of a hunting dog with a sting like a spearhead and venom behind it. Its papery fortress nests hold squadrons.

attacks.name: venom
attacks.damage: save at 3/ST per successful attack or take 3 additional hits venom damage

fields.special_abilities: Elves -3 DX vs insects; elusive flight (-4 to hit).

fields.name: Giant Wolverine
fields.description: A wolverine at bear size with a temper the original never needed scaling. It attacks things it cannot eat purely on principle.

fields.name: Wyvern
fields.description: A two-legged dragon-cousin with a venomous tail sting guarding its blind side and a bite guarding the rest. It can use both in a turn, at a price it happily pays.

attacks.name: sting
attacks.damage: 1d6 to side or back hexes; if armor is penetrated, save at 4/ST or take 2d6 venom damage

fields.special_abilities: Dual attack (-4 DX to both if used in the same turn); flight (-4 to hit).; Scales stop 2 hits; MA 6/12 (land/air); Source ST 10-18
